requirements.requirement: Maintain solvency margin ratio (Biên khả năng thanh toán) at or above 100% at all times; below 100% triggers MoF corrective action, below 80% triggers enhanced supervision
Maintain minimum charter capital (Vốn điều lệ): VND 750 billion for life insurance, VND 400 billion for non-life insurance, VND 500 billion for reinsurance, VND 8 billion for brokers

Calculate and maintain technical provisions (DPNV) per prescribed methodology: mathematical reserve (life), unearned premium reserve (non-life), outstanding claims reserve (case + IBNR), catastrophe/equalization reserve
Invest insurance funds according to MoF-prescribed asset allocation limits including minimum government bond holdings and maximum equity and real estate exposure
Register all insurance products with MoF/ISA before market launch, including actuarial certification, policy terms, premium schedules, and benefit illustrations
Provide a 21-calendar-day cooling-off period (thời gian xem xét hợp đồng) for all life insurance policies from date of policy delivery, with full premium refund minus medical exam costs
Provide mandatory benefit illustration (bảng minh họa quyền lợi) to customers before sale of any life insurance product, in plain language with clear explanation of risks
Complete mandatory written needs analysis form for all bancassurance sales documenting the customer's actual insurance needs
Prohibit forced bundling of insurance with banking products — customers must confirm voluntary purchase separate from loan or deposit transactions
Encourage or require audio/video recording of bancassurance sales conversations and separate insurance sales from banking counter services

Issue compulsory motor third-party liability insurance (BH TNDS) for all registered vehicles with government-fixed premiums covering VND 150M per person bodily injury and VND 100M property damage per incident
Issue compulsory fire and explosion insurance for all facilities on the government-designated high-risk list (Danh mục cơ sở nguy hiểm) with MoF-prescribed premium rates
Require compulsory professional liability insurance for insurance brokers, notaries, and construction consultants as mandated by decree
Ensure all insurance agents complete required training (minimum 48 hours for life, 24 hours for non-life) and pass MoF-approved examination before selling
File Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) with Cục Phòng chống Rửa tiền within 48 hours when transactions suggest money laundering or terrorist financing
Conduct Customer Due Diligence (KYC/CDD) for all policyholders; apply Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for PEPs, high-risk customers, and large single-premium policies
Retain all customer identification records, transaction records, and STR documentation for minimum 5 years after contract termination
Obtain explicit consent for processing health and financial personal data, conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) for large-scale processing, and comply with data residency requirements
Settle insurance claims within the timeframe specified in the policy contract; provide written reasons for any claim denial within prescribed period
Monitor combined ratio (loss ratio + expense ratio) as key underwriting profitability metric; target below 100% for non-life lines

requirements.requirement: Monitor and report 13th-month and 25th-month persistency rates for life insurance; investigate and remediate when persistency drops below industry benchmarks indicating potential mis-selling
Place reinsurance with reinsurers meeting MoF credit quality standards; maintain adequate retention levels; report reinsurance arrangements to ISA
Submit quarterly solvency reports, annual audited financial statements, actuarial reports, product reports, and agent statistics to MoF/ISA within prescribed deadlines

Comply with microinsurance product requirements including maximum premium and sum insured thresholds, simplified underwriting, and approved distribution channels (cooperatives, social organizations, post offices)
Maintain corporate governance structure with HĐQT (Board of Directors), independent audit committee, separation of management and oversight, and fit-and-proper requirements for executives
